en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie, and someone else, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Accursed is the one who is a leader! Accursed is the one who intends with it! Accursed is the one who discusses to himself with it!’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi’ and others in a marfu’ manner who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Condemned is one who seeks leadership, condemned is one who intends to become a leader and condemned is one who speaks to himself of leadership.’”
